cache._comment: v20: ttl_minutes 0 = no expiry (results are keyed by the data version, a new load replaces them). persist_path keeps results in a file so a restart starts warm; empty = memory only.

report_store._comment: v25: saved report settings, schedules and history. url empty = SQLite file sqlite_path (local). Online: VDASH_REPORT_DB_URL = postgres://user:password@host:port/db (Aiven), plus the CA certificate as a file path (VDASH_REPORT_DB_CA) or as text (VDASH_REPORT_DB_CA_PEM); with a CA the server certificate and host name are verified (sslmode verify-full).

llm._comment: v37: AI writer for reports. provider: deepseek | gemini | openai | anthropic; the API key comes ONLY from the environment (DEEPSEEK_API_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) - config/local.env locally, the Render environment online. model empty = the provider's default (deepseek-v4-pro). prices: USD per 1M tokens [input, output] for cost tracking - keep them up to date with the provider's price list. thinking (DeepSeek only): off | low | high | max - how much the model reasons before writing (better analysis, slower, more output tokens); its reasoning counts as output, so max_output_tokens must leave room; a cut-off answer is retried with twice the limit up to max_tokens_ceiling.

report_jobs._comment: v41: reports are written in the background in this process. workers = reports written at the same time; a job whose process stopped (restart, redeploy) is taken over after stale_after_seconds without a heartbeat (beat_seconds) and written again, at most max_attempts times - then it fails and is not counted.
